item.title: [LOW] Microsoft Strengthens NuGet Supply Chain Security By Reducing API Key Lifetime
item.description: Microsoft is reducing the lifetime of NuGet.org API keys to strengthen supply chain security and reduce the risk of stolen credentials being used to publish malicious .NET packages.
